title: Nike quietly sold its digital products subsidiary RTFKT on December 16 for an undisclosed sum, roughly one year after Nike shuttered the NFT unit (Matthew Kish/Oregonian)
summary: Matthew Kish / Oregonian: Nike quietly sold its digital products subsidiary RTFKT on December 16 for an undisclosed sum, roughly one year after Nike shuttered the NFT unit — Nike has sold one of its subsidiaries, but it's not the one on the minds of some analysts and industry watchers.
